proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro α ι _ _ _ _ c hc
  have hcard : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card (Σ i, Fin (c i)) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
    simp [hc]
  let e : α ≃ Σ i, Fin (c i) := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard
  let ω₀ : α → ι := fun x => (e x).1
  have hfib : ∀ (ω : α → ι) (i : ι), Fintype.card {x // ω x = i} = (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ω x = i)).card := fun ω i => Fintype.card_subtype _
  have hω₀ : ∀ i, Fintype.card {x // ω₀ x = i} = c i := by
    intro i
    have e1 : {x // ω₀ x = i} ≃ Fin (c i) :=
      (e.subtypeEquiv (p := fun x => ω₀ x = i) (q := fun s : (Σ j, Fin (c j)) => s.1 = i) (fun x => Iff.rfl)).trans (Equiv.sigmaSubtype i)
    rw [Fintype.card_congr e1, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hX : ∀ ω : α → ι, ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : α → ι => ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ω x = i)).card = c i) ↔ ∀ i, Fintype.card {x // ω x = i} = c i := by
    intro ω
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hfib]
  have hstab : Fintype.card {g : Equiv.Perm α // ω₀ ∘ g = ω₀} = ∏ i, (c i).factorial := by
    rw [DomMulAct.stabilizer_card]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hω₀ i]
  have hmaps : ∀ σ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm α)), ω₀ ∘ σ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : α → ι => ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ω x = i)).card = c i) := by
    intro σ _
    rw [hX]
    intro i
    rw [← hω₀ i]
    exact Fintype.card_congr (σ.subtypeEquiv (fun x => Iff.rfl))
  have hfiber : ∀ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : α → ι => ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ω x = i)).card = c i), (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => ω₀ ∘ σ = ω)).card = ∏ i, (c i).factorial := by
    intro ω hω
    rw [hX] at hω
    have ec : ∀ i, {x // ω x = i} ≃ {x // ω₀ x = i} := fun i => Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [hω i, hω₀ i])
    let τ : Equiv.Perm α := Equiv.ofFiberEquiv ec
    have hτ : ∀ x, ω₀ (τ x) = ω x := fun x => Equiv.ofFiberEquiv_map ec x
    rw [← hstab, Fintype.card_subtype]
    refine Finset.card_equiv (Equiv.mulRight τ⁻¹) ?_
    intro σ
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h
      funext x
      have := congrFun h (τ⁻¹ x)
      simp only [Function.comp, Equiv.coe_mulRight, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul] at this ⊢
      rw [this]
      have h2 := hτ (τ⁻¹ x)
      have h3 : τ (τ⁻¹ x) = x := by simp
      rw [h3] at h2
      exact h2.symm
    · intro h
      funext x
      have := congrFun h (τ x)
      simp only [Function.comp, Equiv.coe_mulRight, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul] at this ⊢
      have h3 : τ⁻¹ (τ x) = x := by simp
      rw [h3] at this
      rw [this, hτ]
  have htotal := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfiber, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm] at htotal
  exact htotal.symm
target_source: ∀ (α ι : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (c : ι → ℕ), ∑ i, c i = Fintype.card α → (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : α → ι => ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ω x = i)).card = c i)).card * ∏ i, (c i).factorial = (Fintype.card α).factorial
